verses.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves his children too.
This is how we know we love God’s children: we love God and obey his commands.
Loving God means keeping his commands, and his commands aren’t a burden.
Everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
Who overcomes the world? Only the one who believes Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus Christ is the one who came through water and blood—not by water only, but by water and blood. The Spirit testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
There are three that testify:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood. These three agree.
We accept human testimony, but God’s testimony is greater, because it’s the testimony God has given about his Son.
Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony in their heart. Whoever doesn’t believe God has made him out to be a liar, because they haven’t believed the testimony God gave about his Son.
And this is the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
Whoever has the Son has life; whoever doesn’t have the Son of God doesn’t have life.
I’ve written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so you may know you have eternal life.
This is the confidence we have before him: if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
And if we know he hears us—whatever we ask—we know we have what we asked of him.

If you see a brother or sister commit a sin that doesn’t lead to death, pray, and God will give them life. I’m talking about those whose sin doesn’t lead to death. There is sin that leads to death; I’m not saying you should pray about that.
All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that doesn’t lead to death.
We know that everyone born of God doesn’t keep on sinning; the one born of God protects them, and the evil one can’t harm them.
We know that we belong to God, and the whole world lies under the evil one’s power.
We also know that the Son of God has come and given us understanding, so we may know the true God. We are in the true God by being in his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
